verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents a choice of 53 real street addresses across 44 states. It also says the address can be listed on public records instead of your own, and that it works with LegalZoom business formation services. Together these support the street-address and LLC-registration parts of the story, but nothing in the evidence confirms acceptance for bank KYC or vendor forms. missing for 10: explicit statement that addresses are not PO Boxes or are accepted for bank KYC, evidence of acceptance on vendor forms, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I get a real street address (not a PO Box) that works for LLC registration, bank KYC, and vendor forms

citations.quote: Choose from 53 real street addresses across 44 states, including prime locations like Park Avenue in New York and Market Street in San Francisco.
Protect your privacy by listing a virtual business address on public records instead of exposing your own to the public.
Virtual Mail also works with your LegalZoom business formation services
